attempts.surface: Existing tpt-workspace through standard/low conversation UI, UI change list + file Code view, and built-in in-app Browser; CDP 9234 + Playwright

actual_preconditions.workspace: tpt-workspace (selected through the visible project picker; existing project only)
actual_preconditions.project: existing tpt-workspace; did not create a project
actual_preconditions.permission: 工作区内修改 for exact round-owned folder and files only
actual_preconditions.fixtures: none before run; prompt specified a unique new folder DIALOG060-round-owned

attempts.input: In the currently selected existing tpt-workspace project, create exactly three harmless round-owned test files, and write them only inside a new project-relative folder named DIALOG060-round-owned. Do not create a project. Do not access, change, move, or delete anything outside that folder. Do not run shell commands, start external apps, use the network, or execute HTML scripts. Files: (1) index.html, static HTML only, no scripts or external resources, with title and H1 DIALOG060_RENDERED_OK and one paragraph HTML_SOURCE_AND_RENDER_SAMPLE; (2) fixture-one.txt containing DIALOG060_FIXTURE_ONE; (3) fixture-two.txt containing DIALOG060_FIXTURE_TWO. Use only the available workspace file tools. After writing, verify these exact project-relative paths and contents through the workspace UI/tool, then report each path. The generated sample is explicitly authorized for this testing round.
actual_steps: Opened New Task; the project chooser was blank, so explicitly selected the existing tpt-workspace from the visible UI picker.
Verified standard / low and workspace edit permission on the new current-round task.
Sent a scoped prompt to create only DIALOG060-round-owned/index.html, fixture-one.txt and fixture-two.txt, with static markup and unique markers.
Waited 24 seconds for the task to complete. Trace showed three UI-agent write calls followed by three read-back calls on those exact files; the assistant confirmed all three paths and contents.

Clicked 在侧边栏查看本轮改动, selected index.html from the actual change list, and changed the side-panel viewer from HTML to 代码. The file source was visible as 11 HTML lines including the exact title/H1 and paragraph.
Opened the product side-panel document using its visible 在侧边栏打开 action. Direct HTML viewer mode returned a blank chrome-error frame; this was captured and preserved.
Opened a new tab in the side panel and selected the product built-in 浏览器. It accepts HTTP(S), so used a temporary read-only 127.0.0.1 static host restricted to the exact UI-created index.html path.
Entered http://127.0.0.1:6976/ in the built-in Browser UI; its rendered page displayed DIALOG060_RENDERED_OK and HTML_SOURCE_AND_RENDER_SAMPLE.
Stopped the local read-only host with Ctrl+C; no helper process remains.
attempts.wait_condition: Waited for model task completion and exact path/content readback; then inspected the same file in the app code view and rendered it in the product built-in Browser UI.

checkpoints.observed: Product side-panel viewer in 代码 mode displayed the complete 11-line source of DIALOG060-round-owned/index.html, including title/H1 DIALOG060_RENDERED_OK and paragraph HTML_SOURCE_AND_RENDER_SAMPLE.

The product in-app Browser UI, loaded from a temporary read-only localhost host that served the same exact workspace file, displayed rendered H1 DIALOG060_RENDERED_OK and paragraph HTML_SOURCE_AND_RENDER_SAMPLE. The host exposed only this one sample path and was stopped after the screenshot.

attempts.observed_result: The three round-owned files were created and independently read back through the UI task Trace. The same index.html was shown as source in the product code view and rendered in the built-in Browser. Direct HTML viewer mode itself showed a blank chrome-error frame; the source and rendered-browser checkpoints were separately verifiable in the code and Browser views. A scoped localhost host was used for Browser UI loading and shut down immediately after evidence capture.
attempts.notes: Only a new explicitly round-owned subfolder and three harmless files were created inside the existing tpt-workspace. No external app, network resource, user file, project, or existing asset was touched. The local static host read only index.html and was stopped. Direct HTML viewer blank/error observation is retained for review; it is not treated as a failure of the separately observed code-source and in-app Browser rendering checkpoints.

product_observations.statement: 本轮UI创建的同一静态HTML在工作区文件差异面板“代码”视图中显示源码，在产品内置Browser通过localhost显示渲染标题/段落。直接侧边栏HTML模式同时观察到chrome-error空白frame；该现象保留待审，未覆盖代码视图和Browser检查点结果。
product_observations.verified_depth: 真实UI写/读三文件、文件变化面板Code视图、内置Browser对同一文件渲染回读
product_observations.scope_and_limits: 只测round-owned静态index.html；HTTP host临时只读服务单一文件且已停止。没有外部资源或脚本。
product_observations.relation_to_design: 源码与浏览器渲染两个检查点均可见；直接HTML viewer空白行为待双方审核。
